evals.prompt: /hyp-owner-grill #113 with issue-a.md and the stand-in owner of standin-a.md, repository and hyp at a51f140.
evals.expected_output: A Goal with lines for #113, written without repeating S1 to S6 of #146.

assertions.text: The grill wrote at least one Goal with lines.

Each Goal with lines that the grill wrote is in a store under the directory the clone's AGENTS.md names for trees (investigations/), in the existing store there that holds a Goal of the issue's parent when one does, and no store is at the clone's top directory.
conversation.md shows no hyp init run in the clone's top directory: every hyp init the grill ran has a cwd, or a cd in the same command, inside a directory below the top.

The issue's candidate is a read command (hyp prompt). No [N] line of a Goal the grill wrote says that a write is refused or that a log is rejected on replay, and each [N] line names the output, exit code or refusal by which the candidate's tests decide it.

No message the grill sent the owner puts to the owner, as a choice among options, a part of a test method that ak-skill-creator's eval flow owns (its eval cases, fixtures, how clauses or assertions are matched, or how they are graded). About the test method the grill asks the owner only whether to use that flow, and the owner's preferences of model, trial count and budget.
No line of a Goal the grill wrote names a file by a sha256 shorter than 64 hex digits.
No line of a Goal the grill wrote names its grader (a test, a script, an eval, a reviewer or a rubric) without the one command or assertion that decides the line.

In each Goal with lines that the grill wrote, no May change: line limits skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md or README.md to named files or named parts of them, and no Never: line forbids a new recipe directory (for example by forbidding any edit of recipes/).
